text: On April 11, 2019, the Government of Ontario announced a $90 million investment for the Ontario Seniors Dental Care Program (OSDCP), a new publicly-funded dental program for low-income Ontario seniors. On June 7, 2019, Toronto Public Health (TPH) received a letter (see Appendix A) indicating that the City of Toronto will receive $15,543.3 thousand in additional base funding for 2019-2020 from the Ministry of Health (formerly the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care) (the Ministry) to implement the OSDCP. On August 20, 2019, the Ministry provided the 2019 Public Health Funding and Accountability Agreement stating that the above funding would be prorated at $11,657.4 thousand for the period of April 1 to December 31, 2019.
